text: 市场全天高开回落，三大指数小幅反弹。生物医药股集体爆发，三元基因、石药创新、安科生物等多股涨停。贵金属板块拉升，深中华A、南矿集团涨停。CPO概念股活跃，中京电子涨停，太辰光、联特科技涨超10%。下跌方面，商业航天概念下挫，超捷股份、飞沃科技跌超10%。个股涨多跌少，沪深京三市超4000股飘红，今日成交2.09万亿。截止收盘沪指涨0.24%，深成指涨0.59%，创业板指涨0.64%。
text_en: Markets opened higher but pulled back through the session, with the three major indices posting modest gains. Biopharmaceutical stocks surged collectively, with Sanyuan Gene, CSPC Innovation, Anke Biotech and others hitting the daily limit. Precious metals sector rallied, with Shenzhen Zhongheng Huafa and Nan Kuang Group hitting limit up. CPO concept stocks were active, with Zhongjin Electronics hitting the limit up, and T&S Communications and Linktel Technologies rising over 10%. On the downside, the commercial aerospace concept declined, with SJK Co., Ltd. and Fiwo Technology falling over 10%. Advancers outnumbered decliners, with over 4,000 stocks in the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets trading higher, and turnover reached 2.09 trillion yuan today. At the close, the Shanghai Composite rose 0.24%, the Shenzhen Component Index rose 0.59%, and the ChiNext Index rose 0.64%.
